messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: oncall-triggered — low-latency-slo-frontend (threshold breach). 3% of requests > 800ms in the last 2m. Alert fired and notified SRE rotation.
jonathan: seeing it too, spikes started ~1:42pm UTC. Any customer reports?
maria: no alerts in support ticketing, quick query shows a small uptick in 99p latency on /v1/generate (inference). looks correlated with model-serving nodes falling back to CPU briefly.
alex: confirmed CPU fallback — I see a bunch of pods in k8s with imagepull backoff? hmm. `kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep -E "serve|proxy"` shows 2 pods restarting in the last 90s.
jonathan: pinging the infra deploys board — any deploys around 1:40pm?
maria: nothing on deploys. control plane shows autoscaler churn. could be KV cache warmup causing regen paths to recompile and bump CPU temporarily.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by jonathan (oncall). Escalation paused.
jonathan: ack — I'll take first pass. Quick mitigation: roll traffic to fallback model variant in same pool (lower mem but CPU-friendly). can someone run the routing override?
alex: I can flip a quick route override — adding a traffic-rule to send 30% to the replica set with auto-quantized weights. Doing it now: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/route/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","split": [70,30]}'`
maria: routing change applied, monitoring metrics. latency 99p down from 820ms -> 420ms in the last 30s.
sre-rotation: good short-term. Are we seeing any customer errors (5xx) or degraded outputs?
johnathan: no 5xx spike, only latency. looks like graceful degrade. I'll keep the PD ack active while we watch for 10m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (low-latency-slo-frontend) — condition returned to normal at 1:44pm UTC.
alex: system shows the problematic node cleaned up itself; the autoscaler killed the flapping pod and new warm node stabilized. I left the routing override in place at 30% to smooth traffic for another 5m.
maria: filing a quick ticket for follow-up: intermittent CPU fallback during KV cache regen; action items: add tighter autoscale cooldown, add a synthetic that exercises warm paths during canaries. I'll assign to runtime-team.
jonathan: thanks. Postmortem not required (no customer impact, auto-resolved), but let's add a short blameless note in the incident board and schedule a 15-min sync with runtime next week.
sre-rotation: noted. marking as handled. repeating pages: we got one PD trigger and then the auto-resolve; but there was a flapping symptom (2 restarts) so watch for recurrence.
alex: adding alert tuning suggestion — bump the rolling window to 3m to avoid noisy 1m spikes for this metric.
maria: ack, I'll include that recommendation in the ticket. :white_check_mark: 
jonathan: closing thread; if anything else pops up I'll reopen. :thumbsup:
